audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].side and phases[6].side said 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] said 'Aurelion Sol' — two answers for the same two rows.
audit.why: phases[5].why and phases[6].why both describe the post-item stages as clearly his, and the content layer already said so.
audit.corrected: Both full-layer sides set to 'Aurelion Sol'; rows 0-4 stay Neeko, consistent with 48.32% over 298 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pop Blossom was described as a 'root-and-burst' tool in mid, whys[4], spikes[1] and wants.foe[1]; the Aurelion Sol ultimate was called 'Voice of Light' twice and Breath of Light was called 'Q Starfire'.
audit.why: Riot kit: Pop Blossom knocks up all nearby enemies, then damages and STUNS on landing — the root in this matchup is Tangle-Barbs (E). Aurelion Sol's R is Falling Star / The Skies Descend; his Q is Breath of Light.
audit.corrected: Knock-up-then-stun stated everywhere the root claim was, real names used, and the 120/105/90s cooldown given.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said that Neeko's CC ends the Breath of Light channel, and nothing mentioned that Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden while she is disguised.
audit.why: Breath of Light and Astral Flight are both interruptible channels; Tangle-Barbs roots from 1000 range and Pop Blossom stuns inside 600. Riot's text: 'The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.' That is the single most punishing hidden mechanic in the matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0], spikes[1], whys[4], mid and dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file claims Astral Flight 'shuts off' Pop Blossom via the enemy-dash-deniable rule.
audit.why: Astral Flight is Aurelion Sol's own flight over terrain, not a grounding or a wall. Whether it denies Pop Blossom's leap is not supported by either kit's text.
audit.corrected: I wrote only the defensible version — Astral Flight is your exit from her 600-unit radius during the wind-up — and did not claim it shuts the ability off.

edits.before: Pop Blossom's root-burst combo at 6 threatens a kill before your own ultimate is a real answer.
edits.after: Pop Blossom knocks up then stuns at 6, and while she is disguised, the wind-up is hidden.

edits.before: Your wide-zone ultimate and superior late-game scaling bury her short-range burst kit in teamfights.
edits.after: The Skies Descend outranges a 600-unit Pop Blossom, and your beam burns her whole side for its duration.

edits.before: Neeko's disguise mechanic lets her ambush you from a minion or bush with Blooming Burst-Tangle-Barbs combos, punishing your predictable farming pattern before your Q Starfire is threatening enough to deter her.
edits.after: Inherent Glamour lets her walk up as an ally or a minion, then open Blooming Burst into Tangle-Barbs from 1000 range — the root cancels Breath of Light, so channel only after you have seen her E leave.

edits.before: Neeko's Pop Blossom ult roots and heavy-damages anyone caught in its radius, and she can chain it into an all-in with her team roaming, while your slower R can't answer a sudden burst window.
edits.after: Pop Blossom knocks up and then stuns everything within 600 units, and the wind-up is invisible while she is disguised — Astral Flight is the only exit, so never spend it poking before level 6.

edits.before: Your Voice of Light ultimate covers a wide zone that Neeko's short-range burst kit can't easily escape, and your scaling magic damage output outpaces her early-heavy damage profile in extended teamfights.
edits.after: The Skies Descend drags her group into the singularity and Neeko has no dash out of it once Pop Blossom is spent, while your stardust beam keeps scaling past her front-loaded burst profile.

edits.before: Neeko can hide inside the minion wave or in brush and burst you the moment you commit to a last-hit, so play cautiously, ward the bushes near your wave, and lean on Q Starfire's range rather than stepping up for risky CS.
edits.after: Neeko can stand in your wave wearing an ally's face and open the moment you commit to a last-hit, so ward the side bushes, count your team, and last-hit at Breath of Light's 750 range rather than stepping up for risky CS.

edits.before: Her Pop Blossom ultimate is a heavy root-and-burst tool that she'll combo with a roam or dive — respect this cooldown around level 6 and don't get caught pushed up alone, since your own R doesn't threaten fast enough to punish her all-in in time.
edits.after: Pop Blossom is a knock-up into a stun, not a root, and it is a 120s cooldown at rank 1 — respect it around level 6, keep Astral Flight banked as the exit, and never stand pushed up alone where she can land it on you and a minion wave at once.

edits.before: The late game is yours: once you've got your core burst item, your Voice of Light covers a huge area that her short-ranged disguise-burst kit can't dodge, and your scaling damage output simply outpaces her early-game-oriented kit in prolonged teamfights.
edits.after: The late game is yours: once you've got your core burst item, The Skies Descend covers ground her 600-unit Pop Blossom cannot, so she has to walk into your beam to reach anyone, and your stardust scaling simply outpaces a front-loaded kit in prolonged teamfights.

edits.before: Farm safely with Q from range until your first item is online
edits.after: Last-hit at Breath of Light's 750 range until your first item

edits.before: Land Pop Blossom to root and burst you down with team follow-up
edits.after: Land Pop Blossom to knock you up and stun you for the follow-up

edits.before: Neeko wins by landing Tangle-Barbs (Root), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Neeko wins by rooting your channel with Tangle-Barbs, then landing Pop Blossom out of a disguise you never read.

edits.before: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, burn Neeko on every W rotation, and group early — your beam turns small mid-game leads into unanswerable objective control.
edits.after: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, ward her flanks so no disguise reaches you, and group early — she needs a 120s Pop Blossom to matter and you need only the beam.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by scaling past her: Pop Blossom is a 90s cooldown even at rank 3, and every stardust stack you bank is permanent while hers resets to zero.

edits.before: Best wave: a back-line E execute pattern that clears from safety while you bank stardust — the wave dies and you never stepped forward. Worst wave: a shoved wave at his tower pre-6 with your W down — you are the slowest, most killable mage in the game in that picture. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.
edits.after: Best wave: a back-line E execute pattern that clears from safety while you bank stardust — the wave dies and you never stepped forward. Worst wave: a wave shoved to her tower pre-6 with Astral Flight down — Tangle-Barbs roots you at 1000 range and Pop Blossom finishes it. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Neeko for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: Falling Star is your only self-peel — hold the 120s stun for her Pop Blossom commit, not for the wave, and never channel Q while it is her window.

edits.before: That’s Neeko’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs roots you from 1000 units and ends the whole channel instantly.

edits.before: Channelling Q face-to-face inside his engage range with W down — every champion that touches you wins that exchange pre-items.
edits.after: Pop Blossom lands as a knock-up and then a stun, so below half health you simply die inside the beam tick you were greeding.

notes: Neeko is female; tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[1].t, report[0].t, report[3].t, report[9].t and report[11].t all say 'his'/'him'. Duplicated strings across fields, better swept by tool. Whether Astral Flight can deny Pop Blossom's leap is not in either kit text and was not asserted. Whether Inherent Glamour's disguise survives the pull of your E black hole is unknown.
